state_ownership.javascript: No lifecycle: math registration retains no mutable state, requires no polling or cleanup, and functions operate only on caller-owned arrays.
state_ownership.lua: No lifecycle: math registration retains no mutable state, requires no polling or cleanup, and functions operate only on caller-owned tables and temporary C arrays.
state_ownership.wasmtime: WasmCanvasContext owns the memory/error adapter state; math has no independent registry entry and is destroyed with that parent runtime.
state_ownership.browser_wasm: No native lifecycle: imports operate on the current browser WebAssembly instance memory and are discarded with that instance.

typescript.description: In-place 3D math helpers. Matrices, vectors, and quaternions use caller-owned Float32Array storage; mat4 values are column-major.
